responsibility: Tests Apple target-spec invariants, including that simulator targets expose the `sim` ABI and that macOS targets remove only cross-compilation deployment environment variables from the link environment.
same_name_distinction: Unlike `src/tests.rs`, which tests generic `Target::from_json` diagnostics, and `spec/abi/tests.rs`, which tests ABI registry lookup/index invariants, this file checks Apple-specific target constructors, asserting simulator targets set the `sim` ABI and Darwin targets preserve only the expected macOS link-environment removals.
